name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.valueAt_mem_valueField
summary: Write φ^{−a}x with a denominator r and expand τ^h·r·φ^{−a}x = Σ_l t_l·v_l in the span of kisinLoc; apply φ^a to this relation first, then an S-linear coordinate λ_i to its coefficients (frame theorem): λ_i(φ^a(τ^h r))·x and Σ_l λ_i(φ^a t_l)·φ^a(v_l) agree under valueAt, so μ(φ^{−a}x) is a quotient of images of S-elements and values μ(v_l), all in 𝒦_a. (λ_i need not commute with φ, so φ^a must be applied before λ_i.)

steps.claim: φ^{−a}x ∈ fracSpan(L): some r ≠ 0 in A_inf has r·φ^{−a}x in the A_inf-span of 1 ⊗ L (hr, e).
steps.lean: have ⟨r, hr, e⟩ := smul_mem_fracSpan («φ» ^ a)⁻¹ (kisinLocAinf_le_fracSpan hx.1)

steps.claim: By the frame theorem and span_kisinLoc, r·φ^{−a}x (times τ^h) is a finite A_inf-combination Σ t_l·v_l of elements v_l of kisinLoc(L) (E).
steps.lean: have ⟨_, t, v, E⟩ := mem_span_set'.1 (span_kisinLoc.ge (le_saturateBy (frame_theorem.2.2.1 _ e)))

steps.claim: Choose a coordinate λ_i of the adic basis of A_inf over S with λ_i(φ^a(τ^h·r)) ≠ 0 (step 4); it suffices to write valueAt(L, a, μ, x) = μ(φ^{−a}x) = D⁻¹·Σ_l φ^{−a}(λ_i(φ^a t_l))·μ(v_l), with D = φ^{−a}(λ_i(φ^a(τ^h·r))) (φ^{−a} = phiInvToBdR a on S; the coefficient +τ^h·r of x, i.e. the coefficient −τ^h·r of the zero relation moved across the equality), and to show the right side is in 𝒦_a:
steps.lean:
(not_forall.1 · |>.elim fun i m ↦ mem_of_eq_of_mem ((eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ (by simpa)).2 (by
  simpa [S_smul,
    neg_add_eq_zero, -LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower] using congr(valueAt a μ $(frame_theorem.1.1
   (k.adicBasis.coord i) (Option.rec _ _) («φ» ^ a • ·.elim (-(tau ^ L.jumpBound * r)) t)
    (.imp_left (kisinLocAinf_le_fracSpan ·) <| ·.rec hx (phi_pow_mem_kisinLoc <| v · |>.2))
    (by simpa [smul_sum, frobGroup_smul_smul, smul_smul, neg_add_eq_zero] using
    congr(«φ» ^ a • $E.symm)))))) (mul_mem (inv_mem (phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField _))
    (sum_mem fun l _ ↦ mul_mem (phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField _) (valueField_zero_le (by simp [valueAt,
    (v l).2.2, *])))))

steps.claim: the identity: apply φ^a to E, which gives the relation φ^a(−τ^h·r)·x + Σ_l φ^a(t_l)·φ^a(v_l) = 0 among vectors of fracSpan (x ∈ kisinLoc, φ^a v_l ∈ kisinLoc: kisinLocAinf_le_fracSpan, phi_pow_mem_kisinLoc); then apply the frame theorem's coordinate relation (an S-linear map A_inf → S applied to the coefficients preserves relations) with λ_i to these coefficients, and evaluate with valueAt(L, a, μ) (valueAt(L, a, μ, φ^a v_l) = μ(v_l)); moving the term of x across the equality changes the sign of its coefficient.
steps.lean:
simpa [S_smul,
    neg_add_eq_zero, -LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower] using congr(valueAt a μ $(frame_theorem.1.1
   (k.adicBasis.coord i) (Option.rec _ _) («φ» ^ a • ·.elim (-(tau ^ L.jumpBound * r)) t)
    (.imp_left (kisinLocAinf_le_fracSpan ·) <| ·.rec hx (phi_pow_mem_kisinLoc <| v · |>.2))
    (by simpa [smul_sum, frobGroup_smul_smul, smul_smul, neg_add_eq_zero] using
    congr(«φ» ^ a • $E.symm))))))

steps.claim: each factor lies in 𝒦_a: φ^{−a} of elements of S do (phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField), and μ(v_l) ∈ 𝒦_0 ⊆ 𝒦_a since v_l ∈ kisinLoc (valueField_zero_le).
λ_i(φ^a(−τ^h·r)) ≠ 0 for some i, because φ^a(−τ^h·r) ≠ 0 (r ≠ 0, τ ≠ 0, φ bijective) and an element with all coordinates 0 is 0.
